DataTypeName.summary: Gets or sets the DataTypeName value.

PropertyName.summary: Gets or sets the PropertyName value.

Value.summary: Gets or sets the Value object.

IsChanged.summary: Gets or sets the changed indicator.

OriginalValue.summary: Gets or sets the original value.

ParamConstructor.summary: Initializes an object instance with the supplied values.

Clone.summary: Creates and returns a clone of the object.

FormatValue.summary: Formats the column value for the SQL string.

remarks.para: Returns the string formatted value from the Value property based on the DataTypeName property.

If the DataType is Boolean, returns "1" or "0".
If the DataType is DateTime, returns a string Date or Minimum Date value.
If the DataType is string, returns a string with doubled single quotes.

CreateColumn.summary: Creates a combined LJCDataColumn from a LJCDataValue and LJCDataColumn.
